topic: A person finds out their surprise party has been cancelled
text: The note lay on the kitchen table, its edges curling slightly from the damp morning. It seemed to whisper secrets of skies and seas, of plans and papers that danced away like autumn leaves. The surprise party, it said, was to be a memory woven into tomorrow, not today. Yet, the sun spills through the window, a gentle reminder of the day's relentless invitation to simply be. So, I step outside, the soft grass tickling my feet, and decide the day will bloom in its own way, unplanned and free, just like the wildflowers at the edge of the garden.
